empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill, or import one from a markdown file or a .zip archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: An imported skill's text becomes instructions in your agent's prompt. Read it before you enable it.
file.success: Imported "{name}". It stays disabled until you enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side and left disabled until you enable it. An imported skill's text becomes instructions in your agent's prompt. Read it before you enable it.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an imported file. An imported skill's text becomes instructions in your agent's prompt. Read it before you enable it.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new version.
preview.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? {count, plural, =0 {No agent uses it.} one {It is linked to 1 agent, which will lose it.} other {It is linked to # agents, which will lose it.}}

form.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface. Write it as a directive that says when the skill applies, e.g. "Use when a PR changes a route's request or response."
form.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what the reviewer must check…

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md file or a .zip archive. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.trustNotice: An imported skill's text becomes instructions in your agent's prompt. Read it before you enable it. Files other than the skill's markdown are never extracted or run.
import.ignoredHint: Listed only: never extracted, saved or run.

rail.agents: {count, plural, =0 {No agents} one {1 agent} other {# agents}}

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

stats.usedByHint: Agents that have this skill enabled. Their prompt includes it on every run.
stats.noAgents: No agent has this skill enabled yet.
stats.notTracked: Not tracked yet: findings are not attributed back to the skill that shaped them.

versions.title: Versioning
versions.hint: Every change to the name, description, type or body saves a version. Toggling Enabled does not.
versions.diffLabel: Changes from v{version} to the current version
versions.noChanges: Same body as the current version.
